functions.name: GetNumSubCurves
functions.docs: Get number of 'sub curves' in this Curve. For example, a vector curve will have 3 sub-curves, for X, Y and Z.

functions.name: GetSubCurveButtonColor
functions.signature: GetSubCurveButtonColor(Target, Sub Curve Index, Is Sub Curve Hidden)

functions.name: GetKeyIn
functions.docs: Get the input value for the Key with the specified index. KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: GetKeyOut
functions.docs:
Get the output value for the key with the specified index on the specified sub-curve.
SubIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumSubCurves.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: GetKeyColor
functions.signature: GetKeyColor(Target, Sub Index, Key Index, Curve Color)

functions.name: EvalSub
functions.docs: Evaluate a subcurve at an arbitary point. Outside the keyframe range, curves are assumed to continue their end values.

functions.name: GetKeyInterpMode
functions.docs:
Get the interpolation mode of the specified keyframe. This can be CIM_Constant, CIM_Linear or CIM_Curve.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: GetTangents
functions.signature: GetTangents(Target, Sub Index, Key Index, Arrive Tangent, Leave Tangent)
functions.docs:
Get the incoming and outgoing tangent for the given subcurve and key.
SubIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumSubCurves.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: GetInRange
functions.docs: Get input range of keys. Outside this region curve continues constantly the start/end values.

functions.name: GetOutRange
functions.docs: Get overall range of output values.

functions.name: CreateNewKey
functions.docs:
Add a new key to the curve with the specified input. Its initial value is set using EvalSub at that location.
Returns the index of the new key.

functions.name: DeleteKey
functions.docs:
Remove the specified key from the curve.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: SetKeyIn
functions.signature: SetKeyIn(Target, Key Index, New In Val)
functions.docs:
Set the input value of the specified Key. This may change the index of the key, so the new index of the key is retured.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: SetKeyOut
functions.signature: SetKeyOut(Target, Sub Index, Key Index, New Out Val)
functions.docs:
Set the output values of the specified key.
SubIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumSubCurves.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: SetKeyInterpMode
functions.docs:
Set the method to use for interpolating between the give keyframe and the next one.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.

functions.name: SetTangents
functions.signature: SetTangents(Target, Sub Index, Key Index, Arrive Tangent, Leave Tangent)
functions.docs:
Set the incoming and outgoing tangent for the given subcurve and key.
SubIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumSubCurves.
KeyIndex must be within range ie >=0 and < NumKeys.
